cases.displayed_text:
Escalate the discrepancy immediately to the Alderbridge Safeguarding Lead — the policy replaces the previous Finance Manager-first route so the Safeguarding Lead is now the initial escalation contact for any financial concern discovered at a site.

Finance retains and audits the financial records and related appointeeship documentation: resident fund transaction records, appointeeship files and audit findings are kept per the Records Retention Schedule, and the Finance Manager supports the financial record review and conducts quarterly audits across sites once the Safeguarding Lead has taken the concern forward.

Show the Alderbridge Safeguarding Lead as the escalation/contact role on the card, and include the appropriate external referral routes: refer to the local authority safeguarding team (use the local authority’s online or telephone referral form) for concerns meeting the local threshold; where an attorney or deputy may be acting outside their authority refer to the Office of the Public Guardian via the OPG safeguarding referral process; where suspected fraud or a scam is involved refer to Action Fraud via their online or telephone reporting service (and contact police 999/101 immediately if a criminal offence or immediate risk is present).

cases.displayed_text:
The current Uniform Allowance Guidance increases both payments: the one-off new-starter (initial) allowance is now £55 in the first month’s pay, increased from £40 in the previous version; the annual replacement allowance paid every April is now £35, increased from £25 in the previous version.

The current Staff Handbook Full Manual offers a consolidated wellbeing and benefits summary including: the Employee Assistance Programme (confidential counselling and practical advice), a death-in-service benefit provided through the workplace pension scheme, access to an occupational health referral where a health condition affects someone’s ability to work, and a wellbeing check-in offered as part of the return-to-work process following sickness absence.

Under the current Resident Finances and Appointeeship Policy a “financial concern” is escalated to—and the Alderbridge Safeguarding Lead is now the escalation contact for—any financial concern raised at a site.

needs.aspect: Which documents or induction steps describe how the new-starter induction will check that I know how to access the wellbeing services (for example induction programme outline, onboarding checklist, buddy scheme or specific induction checks)?

question_span.quote: how will my induction check that I know how to access them?

cases.displayed_text:
Alderbridge makes several wellbeing services available to every employee: an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) offering confidential, externally provided telephone counselling and self‑help resources that anyone may access directly and free of charge at any time; access to a named mental health first aider at each site for an initial, non‑clinical supportive conversation and signposting; manager‑initiated wellbeing referrals to occupational health (with employee consent except where urgent safeguarding requires escalation); proactive additional debrief opportunities after a death; signposting to independent financial guidance via the EAP; and consideration of reasonable adjustments where a health condition affects someone’s ability to work.

Your induction and onboarding process explicitly embeds checks and routes to these supports: the mandatory induction buddy is introduced to the new starter on day one and serves as an informal, approachable point of contact with a formal check‑in partway through the mandatory four‑week buddy period (and extension if both agree); the New Starter Onboarding Checklist requires the induction handbook to be issued on day one and must be completed and returned to HR within two weeks; and the buddy/induction guidance and onboarding checklist are stated to work alongside the Staff Supervision and Appraisal arrangements, so the buddy introduction, the day‑one handbook issuance and the scheduled follow‑ups form the documented steps by which the induction checks you know how to access support.
